title: Two-Ball Rhythm Dribble
setup: One player with two basketballs in an athletic stance.
steps: Dribble both balls at the same height.
Keep knees bent and eyes forward.
Progress to alternating the dribbles.
progression: Change dribble heights or walk forward while maintaining rhythm.

title: Figure-8 Cone Weave
setup: Place two cones about six feet apart.
steps: Dribble around the first cone.
Cross between the cones.
Continue around the second cone to create a figure-eight path.
progression: Require a crossover at the center of the figure eight.

title: One-Hand Form Shooting
setup: Stand 3 to 5 feet from the basket.
steps: Place the shooting hand under the ball.
Extend upward toward the rim.
Hold the follow-through until the ball reaches the basket.
progression: Back up one step after making three controlled shots.

title: Layup Footwork Progression
setup: Start several steps from the basket at a 45-degree angle.
steps: Walk through the final two steps without a ball.
Add the ball and controlled dribble.
Finish softly off the backboard.
progression: Alternate sides and add a passive defender.

title: Hesitation & Go
setup: Use a cone or defender near the perimeter.
steps: Attack under control.
Briefly rise and slow the dribble.
Drop low and explode past the obstacle.
progression: Add a live defender and require a finish.

title: Retreat Dribble Press Break
setup: Ballhandler begins under controlled defensive pressure.
steps: Protect the ball with the body.
Retreat diagonally to create space.
Change direction and attack the open lane.
progression: Use a second defender to simulate a trap.

title: Give & Go
setup: Two offensive players on the perimeter with a defender or cone.
steps: Pass to the teammate.
Immediately cut toward the basket.
Receive the return pass in stride and finish.
progression: Add a live defender denying the return pass.

title: Defensive Slide Box
setup: Arrange four cones in a rectangle.
steps: Begin in a low defensive stance.
Slide laterally to each cone without crossing the feet.
Stay square while changing directions.
progression: Coach points randomly to determine direction.

title: Drop-Step Pivot Footwork
setup: Start on the low block with back or shoulder toward the basket.
steps: Establish the pivot foot.
Drop the opposite foot toward the baseline or lane.
Protect the ball and finish strong.
progression: Read a live defender and select the correct direction.

title: Hit-Find-Go Rebounding
setup: Place an offensive player and defender near the lane with a coach or shooter.
steps: Make legal body contact on the shot.
Turn and locate the basketball.
Pursue the rebound with two hands.
progression: Play live after the rebound with an outlet target.

title: Catch-and-Shoot Spots
steps: Move into the first spot ready to shoot.
Catch on balance and shoot immediately.
Relocate quickly to the next spot.
progression: Add a closing defender or timed makes goal.

title: Closeout & Contain
setup: Defender starts in the paint; ballhandler starts on the perimeter.
steps: Sprint toward the ballhandler.
Shorten steps and arrive balanced.
Influence the drive and slide to contain.
progression: Play live for three dribbles after the closeout.
